nl.title: E-mailforwarders en aliases aanmaken in CyberPanel
nl.excerpt: E-mailforwarders en aliases aanmaken in CyberPanel: praktische handleiding in CyberPanel, met stappen, controles en wanneer je TripleZero iT support inschakelt.
nl.bodyHtml:
Forwarders en aliases sturen mail door zonder volle mailbox — handig voor info@ → persoonlijke inbox.

Aanmaken

  1. Ga naar Email → Forwarders / Aliases.
  2. Kies bronadres op jouw domein.
  3. Vul bestemmingsadres in (intern of extern).
  4. Test met een mail van een extern account.

Tip: Combineer forwarders spaarzaam met catch-all — dat vergroot spamrisico.

Heb je na het volgen van deze stappen nog vragen? Neem contact op met TripleZero iT support via het ticketssysteem. Vermeld hostname, CyberPanel-URL en wat je precies ziet (foutmelding of screenshot).

Gerelateerd: Catch-all; SPF/DKIM.

en.title: Create E-mailforwarders and aliases in CyberPanel
en.excerpt: Alias, forward, catch-all or shared mailbox: pick the right type in DirectAdmin and test.
en.bodyHtml:
“Create E-mailforwarders and aliases in CyberPanel”: alias/forward/catch-all is configured in DirectAdmin Email — not as a ‘signature’.

Preparation

  • DirectAdmin login
  • Source + destination address
  • Whether you need a real mailbox or forward-only

Steps

  1. Decide the type: mailbox (login), forwarder (forward only), alias to an existing mailbox, or catch-all (all@domain).
  2. DirectAdmin → Email Accounts / Forwarders / Catch-All.
  3. Create or change only the intended record; note the destination.
  4. Send a test from an external address to the source address.
  5. Confirm arrival in the destination mailbox (and Spam).

Verify

  • Test mail arrives at the destination

Tip: Catch-all also catches typo-spam — prefer explicit addresses.

Note: Autoresponder on catch-all without limits → loops/spam.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: Create mailbox, SPF, spam filter.
